I didn’t know how to handle these endless moments of loneliness (combined with a and I just started to eat a lot as a coping mechanism: I ate 4-5 times a day, fast-food every week and an exaggerated amount of sweets and chocolate daily. There’s no wonder I’ve gained around 10 kilos in less than 6 months. I feel very guilty for this and I wish I had motivation and energy for going to the gym, but I feel so tired every day. Of course, my family noticed I’m fat and I have a lot of acne on my face due to unhealthy food. Having to accept rude and blunt comments is what bothers me the most. I know fat acceptance is a bullshit and you shouldn’t encourage someone to tolerate their harmful lifestyle, but it does affect me.
